summary: Rebuilds the exponent field of a double by bit manipulation. Copies argument a1 into local v3, then rewrites the high word of v3: the sign bit and the low four mantissa bits are retained from HIWORD(a1) via the mask 0x800F, while the 11-bit exponent field is replaced with (a2 + 1022), encoded as 16 * (a2 + 1022) (shifted left four places). The modified double v3 is returned.

local_names.v3: local double copy of a1 whose high word is rewritten
local_names.a1: input double whose mantissa and sign are preserved
local_names.a2: int16 used to derive the new exponent field value (a2 + 1022)

operations.description: Copy the double argument a1 into the local v3 so its bits can be modified without disturbing the argument.

Rewrite the high word of v3: keep the sign bit and the low four mantissa bits from HIWORD(a1) using the mask 0x800F, and OR in 16 * (a2 + 1022), which places the value (a2 + 1022) into the 11-bit exponent field.
Return v3, the double whose exponent field has been replaced.
